prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: original pixel art sprite atlas for an overhead arcade helicopter game.
Create a production-ready 4 by 4 grid of SIXTEEN distinct ruined CITY BUILDING ROOFTOPS, separated with clear transparent gutters. Canvas square, all 16 cells exactly equal size. GENUINELY TRANSPARENT background outside each building footprint. Each building fits centered inside its cell with at least 12 percent padding on all sides.
CRITICAL CAMERA: perfectly vertical orthographic TOP DOWN / satellite view, looking straight down at flat rooftops. ZERO side walls, ZERO facades, ZERO isometric perspective, no vanishing point, no horizon. These are small background sprites to place between independently drawn streets.
Style: rich 16-bit/32-bit arcade pixel art with intentional hard pixel clusters, coherent limited subdued slate gray, blue-gray concrete, muted rusty metal palette. Detailed like classic military arcade shooters, subtle upper-left lighting, crisp edges. Medium-low contrast to sit behind brightly colored aircraft and enemy bullets. Do not paint road layouts.
Sixteen varied roof plans: L-shaped apartment, broad factory sawtooth skylights viewed vertically, broken office roof, twin circular refinery tanks from above, warehouse with torn roof revealing beams, rooftop helipad with cracked concrete, bombed courtyard block, open collapsed steel truss hall, compact rooftop ventilation unit building, large crumbling apartment roof, narrow loading warehouse, square industrial machinery building, collapsed flat shopping roof, rubble-filled empty foundation, shattered rail maintenance shed, damaged communications building.
Make structural damage believable: uneven missing portions of roofs, exposed rooms, twisted broken beams, buckled panels, cracked concrete, rubble spilling around building footprints, broken parapets. Vary footprint proportions and extent of damage. About half severely damaged, the rest partially damaged. NO orange fire, NO smoke, NO glow (animated effects are added by game code), NO people, NO vehicles, NO text labels, NO grid lines, NO outer border. Maintain true overhead projection consistently in every cell. Export image with alpha transparency.
